greetings.text: Sugeng enjing, Lur. Wonten ingkang saged kula biyantu?
greetings.id: Selamat pagi, Saudara. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?
greetings.en: Good morning. How can I help you?
Excuse me, I would like to file a report.

greetings.text: Piye kabare, Lur? Ana sing isa dibantu?
greetings.id: Apa kabar, Saudara? Ada yang bisa dibantu?
greetings.en: How are you? Is there anything we can help with?

greetings.text: Matur nuwun sanget, laporan panjenengan sampun kacathet.
greetings.id: Terima kasih banyak, laporan Anda sudah tercatat.
greetings.en: Thank you very much, your report has been recorded.

greetings.text: Sugeng rawuh ing layanan warga Bojonegoro.
greetings.id: Selamat datang di layanan warga Bojonegoro.
greetings.en: Welcome to the Bojonegoro citizen service.

complaintTemplates.text: Lur, banyu Bengawan wis mlebu omah nang Ledok Kulon, dhuwure wis sepinggang. Wong tuwa karo bocah cilik kudu dievakuasi saiki, tulung kirim perahu karet.

translation.id: Saudara, air Bengawan Solo sudah masuk rumah di Ledok Kulon, tingginya sudah sepinggang. Lansia dan anak kecil harus dievakuasi sekarang, tolong kirim perahu karet.
translation.en: The Bengawan Solo has flooded homes in Ledok Kulon, water is waist-high. The elderly and small children must be evacuated now, please send a rubber boat.

complaintTemplates.text: Nyuwun sewu, toya Bengawan Solo sampun minggah, sabin kaliyan margi desa ing Kanor sampun kebanjiran. Menawi mangke dalu jawah malih, griyanipun warga saged kelebetan toya. Nyuwun dipun pantau.

translation.id: Mohon maaf, air Bengawan Solo sudah naik, sawah dan jalan desa di Kanor sudah tergenang. Kalau nanti malam hujan lagi, rumah warga bisa kemasukan air. Mohon dipantau.
translation.en: Excuse me, the Bengawan Solo is rising and the rice fields and village road in Kanor are flooded. If it rains again tonight, water could enter people's homes. Please monitor it.

complaintTemplates.text: Tanggule kali nang mburi balai desa bocor, banyune mrembes terus. Yen ora ndang ditambal, sak kampung isa kebanjiran bengi iki.

translation.id: Tanggul sungai di belakang balai desa bocor, airnya merembes terus. Kalau tidak segera ditambal, satu kampung bisa kebanjiran malam ini.
translation.en: The river embankment behind the village hall is leaking and water keeps seeping through. If it is not patched soon, the whole hamlet could flood tonight.

complaintTemplates.text: Banjir wis telung dina durung asat, sumure warga butheg kabeh. Butuh banyu resik karo obat-obatan, utamane kanggo bocah lan wong tuwa.

translation.id: Banjir sudah tiga hari belum surut, sumur warga keruh semua. Butuh air bersih dan obat-obatan, terutama untuk anak-anak dan lansia.
translation.en: The flood has not receded for three days and all the wells are muddy. We need clean water and medicine, especially for children and the elderly.

complaintTemplates.text: Dalan saka Dander menyang kutha bolong-bolong gedhe, wis akeh sing tiba montore. Nek udan, bolongane ketutup banyu dadi ora ketok. Tulung ndang didandani.

translation.id: Jalan dari Dander ke kota berlubang-lubang besar, sudah banyak pengendara motor yang jatuh. Kalau hujan, lubangnya tertutup air jadi tidak kelihatan. Tolong segera diperbaiki.
translation.en: The road from Dander into town is full of big potholes and many motorcyclists have fallen. When it rains the holes fill with water and cannot be seen. Please repair it soon.

complaintTemplates.text: Kula badhe matur, margi wonten Kedungadem sampun rusak awrat, truk ingkang ngangkut tebu asring kandheg. Nyuwun dipun dandosi saderengipun mangsa rendheng.

translation.id: Saya ingin menyampaikan, jalan di Kedungadem sudah rusak berat, truk pengangkut tebu sering terhenti. Mohon diperbaiki sebelum musim hujan.
translation.en: I would like to report that the road in Kedungadem is badly damaged and sugar-cane trucks often get stuck. Please repair it before the rainy season.

complaintTemplates.text: Sampah nang pinggir dalan cedhak pasar wis numpuk seminggu ora diangkut, ambune ora karuan lan akeh laler. Nek udan, sampahe keli mlebu got.

translation.id: Sampah di pinggir jalan dekat pasar sudah menumpuk seminggu tidak diangkut, baunya tidak karuan dan banyak lalat. Kalau hujan, sampahnya hanyut masuk selokan.
translation.en: Rubbish by the road near the market has piled up for a week without collection; it stinks and draws flies. When it rains it washes into the drains.

complaintTemplates.text: Lampu dalan nang prapatan desa mati wis rong minggu, bengi peteng ndhedhet. Akeh sing wedi liwat, kuwatir ana maling.

translation.id: Lampu jalan di perempatan desa mati sudah dua minggu, malam gelap gulita. Banyak yang takut lewat, khawatir ada pencuri.
translation.en: The street light at the village crossroads has been out for two weeks and it is pitch dark at night. People are afraid to pass, worried about thieves.

complaintTemplates.text: Banyu PDAM nang omahku wis telung dina ora mili, nek mili ya mung bengi lan butheg. Tulung dicek pipane.

translation.id: Air PDAM di rumah saya sudah tiga hari tidak mengalir, kalaupun mengalir hanya malam hari dan keruh. Tolong dicek pipanya.
translation.en: The piped water at my house has not run for three days; when it does, only at night and muddy. Please check the pipes.

complaintTemplates.text: Wit asem gedhe nang pinggir dalan ambruk kena angin, nutupi dalan lan kabel listrik pedhot. Montor ora isa liwat babar pisan.

translation.id: Pohon asam besar di pinggir jalan tumbang diterjang angin, menutup jalan dan kabel listrik putus. Kendaraan sama sekali tidak bisa lewat.
translation.en: A big tamarind tree by the road was blown down, blocking the road and snapping the power line. Vehicles cannot get through at all.

complaintTemplates.text: Nyuwun pirsa, Pak. Nalika ngurus surat pindah wonten kantor desa, kula dipunsuwuni arta satus seket ewu tanpa kuitansi. Menapa pancen wonten biayanipun?

translation.id: Mohon tanya, Pak. Waktu mengurus surat pindah di kantor desa, saya dimintai uang seratus lima puluh ribu tanpa kuitansi. Apakah memang ada biayanya?
translation.en: May I ask, Sir: when I processed a moving letter at the village office I was asked for 150,000 rupiah without a receipt. Is there really a fee?

complaintTemplates.text: Puskesmas nang kecamatan antrine dawa banget, dokter mung siji. Anakku panas wis telung dina, esuk nganti awan durung kebagian.

translation.id: Puskesmas di kecamatan antreannya panjang sekali, dokternya hanya satu. Anak saya demam sudah tiga hari, dari pagi sampai siang belum dapat giliran.
translation.en: The queue at the sub-district health centre is very long and there is only one doctor. My child has had a fever for three days and has waited from morning to noon without being seen.

complaintTemplates.text: Nang RT kene wis ana bocah telu kena demam berdarah sak minggu iki. Tulung difogging lan dipriksa jentike.

translation.id: Di RT sini sudah ada tiga anak kena demam berdarah minggu ini. Tolong dilakukan fogging dan pemeriksaan jentik.
translation.en: Three children in our neighbourhood have caught dengue this week. Please carry out fogging and a larva check.

complaintTemplates.text: Kula sampun ngurus KTP-el wiwit kalih wulan kepengker, ngantos sakmenika dereng dados, jarene blangkonipun telas. Nyuwun pirsa kapan saged dipundhut?

translation.id: Saya sudah mengurus KTP-el sejak dua bulan lalu, sampai sekarang belum jadi, katanya blankonya habis. Mohon info kapan bisa diambil?
translation.en: I applied for my e-ID two months ago and it is still not ready; they say the blank cards ran out. When can I collect it?

complaintTemplates.text: Mbahku wis tuwa lan urip dhewe, kok jenenge ilang saka daftar bansos sasi iki. Padahal sasi wingi isih entuk. Tulung dicek, Lur.

translation.id: Nenek saya sudah tua dan hidup sendiri, kok namanya hilang dari daftar bansos bulan ini. Padahal bulan lalu masih dapat. Tolong dicek, Saudara.
translation.en: My grandmother is old and lives alone, yet her name has disappeared from this month's social-assistance list although she received it last month. Please check.

complaintTemplates.text: Atap kelas SD nang desaku bocor lan kayune wis growong, bocah-bocah wedi nek udan deres. Mbok ndang didandani sadurunge ambruk.

translation.id: Atap kelas SD di desa saya bocor dan kayunya sudah keropos, anak-anak takut kalau hujan deras. Tolong segera diperbaiki sebelum roboh.
translation.en: The primary-school classroom roof in my village leaks and the timber is rotten; the children are scared in heavy rain. Please fix it before it collapses.

complaintTemplates.text: Dalan cor nang pinggir kali ambles separo, retake saya amba. Nek ana truk liwat isa ambrol. Nyuwun enggal dipasangi tandha bahaya.

translation.id: Jalan cor di pinggir sungai amblas separuh, retakannya makin lebar. Kalau ada truk lewat bisa ambrol. Mohon segera dipasang tanda bahaya.
translation.en: The concrete road along the river has half subsided and the crack keeps widening; it could collapse under a truck. Please put up warning signs urgently.
